data.body:
`make verify` green and pushed for review.

Run 2: **20,308 passed, 27 skipped, 0 failed** (2,267 s) in the gating `not integration and not external`
phase, then the integration phase, then `VERIFY EXIT: 0`.

Gerrit change **3217**, revision `6f67b53d0716c862212cd00c8523696727bc6912`, hashtag
`rebar-session-6a3fecbb-7c5e-4e07-b1ba-7eb2bd09cb7c`. Awaiting `LLM-Review +1` and `Verified +1`.

Discovered work is filed as [rebar:0461-09ce-4850-42a7] (`corking-groggy-pachyderm`): nothing in
the tree calls `build_vectors`, so until a supported surface invokes it every live entry stays
unvectored, `rank` returns `None` on every call, and the tier this ticket adds degrades to
lexical forever. That is a consequence of this ticket's own design — keeping the build off the
create path — not a defect in it, which is why it is a separate ticket rather than a change here.
0461 now carries a full plan (a `rebar store build-vectors` member) and is reparented under
[rebar:4e89-30b9-1666-4e53] as a sibling of this ticket. Its plan review has to wait for this
change to merge, because the plan cites `src/rebar/similar/embedding.py` and the gate measures
citations against `origin/main`.
